PHYSICS CHECK — Governing relation is the energy balance across the trap: $Q_{in} = Q_{out} + Q_{loss}$, where $Q_{loss}$ is proportional to the blow-through mass flow rate. For a 10 bar saturated steam, the temperature difference between inlet and condensate header pressure dictates the potential for blow-through; a temperature difference exceeding $5^\circ\text{C}$ above the expected saturated condensate temperature at header pressure indicates excessive blow-through.
